title: Event page
description: A simple public page for people without a personal invitation: details, programme, menu and registration.
readOnly: Only the organisers can change the page.

settings.title: What the page shows
settings.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The page will be at {base}/e/your-address
settings.titleEnHint: If left empty, the Romanian one is used.
settings.descriptionHint: Text only — the page has no cover image.
settings.showVenue: The venue and the navigation link
settings.showProgramme: The programme (moments visible to all guests)
settings.registrationHint: Anyone with the page address can sign up with a name, an email and the party size.
settings.datesHint: Leave empty for “from now” and “until I close it”.
settings.sharesCapacity: Places are shared with invited guests
settings.sharesCapacityHint: One count of places for everybody. When it runs out, newcomers join the waiting list.
settings.capacityUnlimited: You have set no capacity: places are unlimited. You can set one under Guests.
settings.privacyUrlHint: Optional. Without it, the form links to the EventDesk notice.
settings.publishedHint: While it is not published, the address answers “page not found”.

questions.title: Registration questions
questions.intro: Few and clear. A question can appear only when another one was answered a certain way.
questions.saveFirst: Save the page first, then add questions.
questions.empty: No questions. The form asks only for the name, the email and how many are coming.
questions.optionsHint: One per line. For English: Da | Yes
questions.removeBody: Answers already given to it will no longer be shown.

registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.heroLabel: People registered on the public page
registrations.empty: Nobody has registered yet. Send the page address to the people you expect.
registrations.waitlistNote: When places free up, the first party that fits gets in automatically and receives one email.
registrations.cancelBody: The places are freed at once and go to the waiting list.
registrations.managersOnly: Names and addresses of registrants are seen by the organisers only.

export.title: Public page registrations (CSV)
export.description: Who registered, party size, status and answers.

lifecycle.label: Public page
lifecycle.cancelNote: Registrants get an email that the event is cancelled.
lifecycle.postponeNote: Registrants get an email with the new date.

public.cancelledBody: We are sorry. If you registered, you also received an email.
public.postponedBody: The date below is the new one.
public.foot: Page made with EventDesk. Form data reaches the organisers only.
public.notFoundBody: Check the address or ask the organisers for it again.
public.throttledBody: Please try again a little later.

form.title: Registration
form.intro: It takes a minute. You get your own link by email to view or cancel the registration.
form.fullNote: All places are taken. You can join the waiting list and we will email you if one frees up.
form.name: Your name
form.emailHint: Only for the confirmation and changes about the event.
form.childrenHint: Only the number — we ask for no names or ages.
form.consent: I agree that the organisers use this data for this event.

result.registeredTitle: You have a place. See you there!
result.waitlistedBody: If places free up, you get in automatically and receive an email.
result.linkBody: Use it to view or cancel your registration. We also emailed it to you — keep it, we cannot show it again.
result.replayed: Your registration is already saved. Your link is in the confirmation email.

manage.name: Name
manage.cancelBody: Your place goes to the next person on the waiting list. You can register again while places last.
manage.goneTitle: This link is no longer valid
manage.goneBody: Check the link in your confirmation email.

email.manageNote: The link is yours alone. Keep this message: for safety, we cannot send it again.
email.why: You receive this message because you registered for this event through EventDesk.

registered.subject: Registered: {event}
registered.body: You have a place at “{event}”. Adults: {adults}, children: {children}.

waitlisted.subject: On the waiting list: {event}
waitlisted.body: All places at “{event}” are taken. You are on the waiting list, position {position}. If places free up, you get in automatically and we will tell you.

promoted.subject: You have a place: {event}
promoted.body: A place freed up and your registration for “{event}” is now confirmed.
promoted.link: The link in the first email still works if you want to view or cancel it.

cancelled.subject: Cancelled: {event}
cancelled.bodyNoDate: We are sorry: “{event}” has been cancelled.

postponed.subject: Postponed: {event}
postponed.body: “{event}” has been postponed. The new date: {date}. Your registration still stands.
postponed.bodyNoDate: “{event}” has been postponed. The new date will be announced. Your registration still stands.

errors.slug: Use 3–60 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, no spaces or accents.
errors.slugTaken: This address is used by another event. Choose another.
errors.privacyUrl: The link must start with https://
errors.closesBeforeOpens: The closing date must be after the opening date.
errors.tooManyQuestions: The form can have at most 12 questions.
errors.twoOptions: Write at least two options, one per line.
errors.tooManyOptions: A question can have at most 12 options.
errors.condition: The condition must point at a choice question placed above that always appears.
errors.conditionChain: Other questions depend on this one, so it cannot itself be conditional.
errors.name: Write your name.
errors.adults: At least one adult, at most 10.
errors.consent: Tick the agreement so we can save the registration.
errors.alreadyRegistered: There is already a registration with this address. Your link is in the confirmation email.
errors.linkGone: This link is no longer valid.
errors.noPlaces: Not enough places: {left} free, {needed} needed. Raise the capacity or wait for a cancellation.
